projectDescription: A simple, immutable ERC-20 token with a fixed supply of 400 million AKAM deployed on the Polygon PoS network.
keyFeatures: Fixed supply of 400,000,000 AKAM — no minting after deployment
Standard ERC-20 compliant (transfer, approve, transferFrom, allowance)
No owner or privileged admin functions — fully decentralized
Deployed on Polygon PoS for low-cost, fast transactions
Built with Foundry and OpenZeppelin Contracts v5
Comprehensive unit and fuzz test suite
publicApiSurface: transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) → bool
